parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;align=left;shadow=1;fixDash=0;comic=0;fillColor=#f5f5f5;fontColor=#333333;strokeColor=#666666;" value="<div><b style="background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));">Nmap:</b><span style="background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));"> Discovers open ports, running services, and maps the underlying network infrastructure of the target.</span></div><div><br></div><div><b>Katana:</b> A fast, next-generation web crawler used to discover active endpoints and map the application's attack surface.</div><div><br></div><div><b>Waybackurls:</b> Retrieves historical and archived URLs from the Wayback Machine to uncover forgotten or legacy endpoints.</div><div><p data-path-to-node="2"><b data-path-to-node="2" data-index-in-node="0">Amass:</b> Performs in-depth DNS enumeration and external attack surface mapping to uncover hidden subdomains and associated infrastructure.</p><p data-path-to-node="3"><b data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="0">Subfinder:</b> Executes rapid, passive subdomain discovery using various OSINT sources to quickly expand the known target scope.</p></div><div><b>Gau (GetAllUrls):</b> Aggregates known URLs from multiple threat intelligence and archive sources to maximize endpoint discovery.</div><div><br></div><div><b>Gobuster / ffuf:</b> Utilized for high-speed directory and parameter fuzzing, executed selectively on specific domains and high-interest endpoints only when deeper discovery is necessary.</div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="461" width="285" x="257.5" y="679" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="N9rKorX5214ZSAnH0RB_-292" parent="1" exploitation of SQL injection flaws to extract data and compromise database servers.</div><div><br></div><div><b>Ghauri:</b> An advanced SQL injection tool specifically utilized for complex injection points and bypassing strict Web Application Firewalls (WAF).</div><div><br></div><div><b>Httpx:</b> A highly scalable HTTP toolkit used to probe live hosts, verify active endpoints, and extract technology fingerprints rapidly.</div><div><br></div><div><b>WPScan:</b> Executes targeted vulnerability scanning against WordPress installations to identify outdated plugins, weak passwords, and misconfigurations.</div><div><br></div><div><b>Shortscan:</b> A specialized reconnaissance tool deployed to detect and exploit IIS short name disclosure vulnerabilities for uncovering hidden files.</div><div><br></div><div><b data-path-to-node="10,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">Burp Suite / Caido:</b> The core intercepting proxy utilized for manual HTTP traffic manipulation, parameter div.span: Discovers open ports, running services, and maps the underlying network infrastructure of the target.

div.div: Katana: A fast, next-generation web crawler used to discover active endpoints and map the application's attack surface.
Waybackurls: Retrieves historical and archived URLs from the Wayback Machine to uncover forgotten or legacy endpoints.

div.p: Amass: Performs in-depth DNS enumeration and external attack surface mapping to uncover hidden subdomains and associated infrastructure.
Subfinder: Executes rapid, passive subdomain discovery using various OSINT sources to quickly expand the known target scope.

div.div: Gau (GetAllUrls): Aggregates known URLs from multiple threat intelligence and archive sources to maximize endpoint discovery.
Gobuster / ffuf: Utilized for high-speed directory and parameter fuzzing, executed selectively on specific domains and high-interest endpoints only when deeper discovery is necessary.

div.div: SQLmap: Automates the detection and exploitation of SQL injection flaws to extract data and compromise database servers.
Ghauri: An advanced SQL injection tool specifically utilized for complex injection points and bypassing strict Web Application Firewalls (WAF).
Httpx: A highly scalable HTTP toolkit used to probe live hosts, verify active endpoints, and extract technology fingerprints rapidly.
WPScan: Executes targeted vulnerability scanning against WordPress installations to identify outdated plugins, weak passwords, and misconfigurations.
Shortscan: A specialized reconnaissance tool deployed to detect and exploit IIS short name disclosure vulnerabilities for uncovering hidden files.
Burp Suite / Caido: The core intercepting proxy utilized for manual HTTP traffic manipulation, parameter tampering, and testing complex business logic flaws.
